Title: Modelling Engineer
Title reason: DOMAIN_AMBIGUITY

# Modelling Engineer
# Location: Bristol / London
# About Fractile
Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world's most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs.
We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on.
Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.
The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress.
The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.
# The Role
# About the Software organisation at Fractile
Developer Experience sits within the Software organisation at Fractile, which is responsible for developing a full software stack for our groundbreaking AI inference systems.
That's everything from ML compilers, device drivers and systems firmware, application level runtime and ecosystem integrations, ML and compute libraries, great developer tooling and a full portfolio of simulators, through to datacenter scale workload deployment solutions.
At Fractile, we know that a fantastic software stack is a critical and central part of any AI inference solution and it sits at the heart of everything we're doing.
# About the team and role
To build hardware that doesn't yet exist, you first have to model it — with precision, depth, and an eye for the trade-offs that matter.
At Fractile, high-fidelity pre-silicon models shape our architecture, performance, and product design long before hardware exists.
The Simulation team includes C++ and SystemC specialists, verification and validation engineers, system architects, and embedded engineers.
This is not a support function — it is the group that defines how Fractile's hardware behaves.
As a Modelling Engineer you will develop the pre-silicon models of Fractile's AI acceleration hardware, enabling architectural exploration and definition, functional modelling, performance modelling and bottleneck analysis, and early software development on virtual platforms.
You will work closely with hardware, software, and ML teams in a true hardware–software co-design loop.
# About you
You have a genuine curiosity for hard problems and the depth to operate across architecture, performance, and functional correctness.
You understand that the models you build will shape the architecture of Fractile's accelerator, determine performance trade-offs, enable early runtime and compiler development, unblock software teams months before silicon exists, and reduce risk across the entire product lifecycle.
You take that responsibility seriously and bring the rigour it demands.
# Key Requirements
- Experience in pre-silicon modelling of complex semiconductor IP
- SystemC or equivalent modelling frameworks
- C++ for high-performance simulation
- Performance modelling and architectural analysis
- Verification and functional modelling
# Nice to Have
- Experience with ML workloads or ML accelerator architectures
- Prior startup or small-team experience
# What We Offer
- Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role
- Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation
- Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance
- Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment
Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time.
We've recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead.
Join us!
# Export controls
Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations.
Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law.
We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

Title: Product Operations Specialist
Title reason: SCOPE_AMBIGUITY

SumUp empowers businesses to get paid effortlessly, process orders fast, sell online in minutes, and manage their money with confidence.
We build the tools that help businesses — and their customer experiences — thrive.
Brazil's Banking Product team sits at the intersection of regulation, payments infrastructure, and product delivery, managing a complex ecosystem of third-party partners, Central Bank requirements, and operational processes that keep millions of transactions running reliably every day.
With our banking products continuing to grow, we're creating a dedicated Product Operations Analyst role to strengthen our operational excellence and help the team scale effectively.
In this role, you'll own the operational foundation that enables the team to move quickly and confidently.
You'll drive regulatory and operational processes, coordinate cross-functional execution, and ensure our banking products operate smoothly and remain compliant, creating the conditions for Product Managers to focus on strategy, innovation, and delivering new value for our merchants.
# What you'll do
- Monitor and evaluate Central Bank of Brazil requirements, coordinate regulatory submissions, and support annual certification processes across the banking ecosystem
- Run and validate monthly transaction uploads into Snowflake, ensuring reconciliation and audit processes are completed accurately and on time
- Manage ticket and inbox operations, maintain SLA visibility, and prepare structured summaries and escalations for Product Managers
- Track and communicate operational changes through governance workflows, keeping all updates documented and traceable across teams
- Coordinate logistics and follow-ups for routine stakeholder meetings with internal teams and external partners such as Pismo, Thales, and Mastercard
- Identify recurring friction points in operational workflows and propose structured improvements to reduce manual effort over time
# You'll be great for this role if…
- Experience working with banking, payment systems, or similarly complex integration-based ecosystems, with a solid understanding of how operational and regulatory processes interact
- Proven ability to manage cross-functional delivery across Engineering, Risk, Compliance, and business stakeholders, keeping priorities clear and ownership well-de fined
- Strong organisational skills and comfort handling high volumes of partner-driven changes, balancing urgency with the discipline to introduce structure over time
- Ability to interpret external partner requirements such as file changes, compliance updates, or configuration adjustments, and translate them into clear, actionable tasks
- Clear written and verbal communication in both Portuguese and advanced English, with the confidence to align stakeholders and document decisions precisely
- Basic SQL skills and a process-improvement mindset, with a natural drive to reduce manual overhead and build more reliable workflows
# Why you should join SumUp
Global Experience: Collaborate with a diverse team of 3,000+ people from over 90 countries, and join our global off-sites and hackathons.
Collaborative Culture: Join a team that values diversity, innovation, and teamwork, where your ideas and contributions truly matter.
Career Growth: Be part of a global team working on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses.
# Great Benefits
Health plans, meal vouchers (VR), Zenklub, Wellhub, life insurance, childcare allowance, and more.
Learning & Development: Access an annual budget of R$ 10,000 for education, certifications, and conferences.
Time Off: Enjoy 30 additional days off through our Break4Me program after 3 years at SumUp.
Grow with Us: Participate in our virtual stock program and benefit from SumUp’s success with company shares.
# About SumUp
Be empowered to do more that matters.
At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive.
Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.
Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team Opens in new window of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset.
Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success.
We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth.
Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.
SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce.
We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy.
Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited.
Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedInOpens in new window, InstagramOpens in new window, and TikTokOpens in new window.

Title: People Science Analyst 12 month FTC
Title reason: DOMAIN_AMBIGUITY

> We’re big believers in the power of IRL, so for most roles we ask Campers to work from their local Culture Amp office an average of 2 days a week to unlock connection, pace and culture together.
> # Join us on our mission to make a better world of work.
> Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,000 companies create a better world of work.
> Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams.
> Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day.
> Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia.
> Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company.
> For more information visit cultureamp.com.
We're looking for a Senior People Science Analyst to join our global People Science Analytics team on a 12-month fixed term contract.
You'll specifically partner with customers across EMEA and North America on bespoke research using Culture Amp and customer-supplied data, owning studies from question through to action.
GenAI tools will be part of that workflow, helping you work more efficiently, as you continue to identify further areas for improvement.
As a thought leader in HR analytics, you'll combine data across diverse customers and use methods from psychology, economics and business to generate advanced insights into how employee experience shapes outcomes like turnover, sales performance and customer satisfaction.
You'll surface trends for the HR community and make complex findings accessible through clear, engaging stories and practical strategies.
The work is technical and customer-facing.
You'll listen closely to customers, bring clarity to methodology and reporting, and collaborate with HR leaders, customer-facing People Scientists, Customer Success Managers and Account Managers to develop studies and insight reports for clients and the wider public.
You'll also help customers and colleagues build confidence with data.
Because the team is small and the projects are complex, you'll have real ownership over which questions are worth answering and how they get answered.
# As part of this team of amazing humans,
# You will
- Lead customer discovery and own studies end to end, from clarifying the business problem and shaping the research question through to design, delivery and recommendations
- Design, clean, combine and explore platform and customer-supplied datasets using robust, reusable approaches that protect participant privacy
- Conduct rigorous statistical analyses across engagement, lifecycle, performance and team effectiveness data, generating actionable and, where appropriate, predictive insights tied to business outcomes
- Use AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, synthesis and communication, while validating outputs, protecting customer data and maintaining methodological rigour
- Collaborate with customer-facing People Scientists on advanced HR analytics projects, applying sound judgment about methods, limitations and trade-offs
- Identify the themes and stories most likely to help organisations improve their culture and business outcomes, then communicate them through clear reports, presentations and internal and external thought leadership
- Create reusable methods, templates and assets; improve internal processes and practices; and negotiate scope, priorities and timelines to deliver high-quality work
# You have
- An advanced degree (Masters or PhD) in organisational psychology, quantitative social science, economics or a related field, or equivalent applied research experience
- Applied experience using quantitative research methods on people or workforce data, ideally connecting survey results to business outcomes
- Strong command of inferential statistics, including regression, multi-level analysis and longitudinal analysis, and the judgment to know which method suits which question
- Working proficiency in R, with real experience cleaning and combining messy datasets from multiple sources
- Experience owning complex analytical work end to end, from an initially ambiguous question through to a clear recommendation or conclusion
- A track record of building decks for HR and executive audiences, and presenting them well
- Strong practical understanding of AI tools and workflows, with the judgment to use them to improve quality, efficiency and insight without replacing methodological rigour
- Experience managing stakeholder expectations on scope, timelines and priorities, including when trade-offs or constraints need to be made explicit
- Experience sharing expertise, improving team practice or creating reusable approaches that help others do better work
# You are
- Curious. You ask open questions, get to the underlying problem and resist offering a solution before you understand it
- An independent owner. You can move complex work forward with limited direction, while knowing when to seek input or challenge an assumption
- A translator. You can make a complex finding land with someone who has no statistical training, without dumbing it down
- A thoughtful methodological partner. You are confident about where your expertise is deep, honest about where it isn't, and clear about the implications
- A multiplier. You share what you know, give useful feedback and leave the team with better methods or assets than you found it with
- Open to feedback and quick to act on it
- Energised by intellectually complex work, and comfortable with the ambiguity that comes with open research questions
> # Perks & Benefits
> At Culture Amp, our people are at the heart of our success.
> We offer competitive pay and a total rewards package designed to support you at work and in life.
> This includes:
> - Equity through our Employee Share Option Program, so you can share in our long-term success
> - Learning programs and coaching to help you thrive and grow
> - Quarterly refresh days, an extended end-of-year break and a monthly allowance to support your wellbeing and lifestyle
> - Inclusive parental leave from day one
> - A MacBook and budget to set up your home workspace, enabling flexibility
> - Five annual social impact days to to give back to causes that matter to you
> - Medical insurance coverage for you and your family (Available for US & UK only)
> Our rewards are designed to support different needs and life stages, recognising that what matters most can vary from person to person.
> Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds may hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every requirement, but your unique experience matters.
> If you’re interested in joining us, we strongly encourage you to apply and help us build a more diverse and impactful team.
> # Accommodations & Data Privacy
> If you require reasonable accommodations or adjustments due to a disability to complete the online application or to participate in the interview process, please contact accommodations@cultureamp.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting.
> Do not include any medical or health information in this email.
> The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.
> Culture Amp will retain your CV & personal information for a period of two years (four years for the US) from the date of your application process completion.
> Culture Amp may contact you in relation to future job opportunities during this time period.
> For further information please see our privacy policy here or contact privacy@cultureamp.com.

Title: IT MES Support Technician
Title reason: SCOPE_AMBIGUITY

> # About Harbinger
> Harbinger is an American commercial electric vehicle (EV) company on a mission to transform an industry starving for innovation.
> Harbinger’s best-in-class team of EV, battery, and drivetrain experts have pooled their deep experience to bring a first-of-its-kind EV platform to support the growing demand for medium-duty EVs and Hybrids.
> Harbinger: Familiar Form, Revolutionary Foundation.
# Position Overview
Harbinger is seeking an IT & MES Support Technician to provide hands-on technical support for our manufacturing operations.
In this role, you will serve as a frontline IT resource on the factory floor, helping ensure production systems, devices, and Manufacturing Execution System (MES) applications remain operational and reliable.
This is an onsite, first-shift position ideal for someone early in their IT career who enjoys troubleshooting, working directly with end users, and gaining exposure to technology within a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
You will work closely with production teams, engineers, maintenance, and senior IT staff to resolve issues, identify recurring problems, and support improvements to our manufacturing systems.
# What You’ll Do
- Provide frontline technical support to operators, supervisors, and production teams experiencing issues with MES, traceability systems, or factory-floor technology.
- Troubleshoot, configure, repair, and deploy IT hardware, including workstations, tablets, barcode scanners, label printers, thin clients, and other production devices.
- Diagnose basic Windows, hardware, application, and network connectivity issues and escalate more complex problems as needed.
- Create, triage, resolve, and document support tickets, including troubleshooting steps, root causes, and resolutions.
- Partner with process engineering, quality, maintenance, and IT teams to investigate recurring production-system issues and support testing of new MES configurations and functionality.
- Perform routine IT administration, including password resets, user account support, and basic Active Directory tasks.
- Conduct preventative checks of critical factory-floor IT equipment to identify potential issues before they disrupt production.
- Support the deployment and implementation of new hardware, software, and manufacturing technology as Harbinger’s production environment continues to scale.
# What You’ll Need
- High school diploma or equivalent.
- Foundational knowledge of Windows 10/11, PC hardware, and general IT troubleshooting.
- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize multiple requests in a fast-paced production environment.
- Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical teams.
- Ability to work onsite during first shift, with occasional flexibility for early start times or shift-crossover meetings.
# Preferred Qualifications
- Associate degree, technical certification, or coursework in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
- Previous experience or exposure to a manufacturing, warehouse, or production environment.
- Familiarity with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), manufacturing processes, or production traceability systems.
- Basic understanding of networking concepts, including IP addresses, switches, and network connectivity.
- Experience with Active Directory, ticketing systems, or end-user IT support.
# Work Environment
This position is 100% onsite and requires regular presence on Harbinger’s manufacturing floor.
The role involves walking and standing throughout the facility, communicating in an active production environment, and occasionally lifting or moving standard IT equipment such as monitors, printers, and workstations.
> # Key Benefits & Perks
> - Comprehensive Health, Dental & Vision (HDV) – 100% employee covered
> - Early-stage Stock Options
> - Robust Retirement Savings (401k, HSA, FSA)
> - Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) & Parental Leave
> - Annual Vacation Bonus
> - Wellness & Fertility Benefits
> - Cell Phone Stipend
> - Complimentary Meals & Stocked Kitchens
> California Pay Range
> $25—$30 USD
> # Equal Opportunity
> Harbinger is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws.
> All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.
> Harbinger is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities.
> If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at info@harbingermotors.com.
> # Candidate Data Privacy
> Harbinger may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”).
> This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information.
> Harbinger may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) recordkeeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.
> Harbinger may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our HR, legal, and finance teams, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Harbinger affiliates; and (iii) Harbinger’s service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services.
> Harbinger may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions.
> Please note that we are currently not accepting applications from third party application services.
> Any unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles submitted in response to our job posting shall be considered the property of Harbinger and are not subject to payment of referral or placement fees if any such candidate is later hired by Harbinger unless you have a signed written agreement in place with us which covers the applicable job posting.

Title: Technical Solutions Analyst Commercial
Title reason: DOMAIN_AMBIGUITY

**This role is located in our Production facility in Norwood, MA, and will follow our Hybrid Work Schedule**
Pay Range: $112,000 – $130,000 annually (based on experience and qualifications)
# OVERVIEW OF ROLE
An embedded techno-functional analyst for HMF's Commercial teams and the functional owner of the trade promotion and deductions platform from the IT side.
The role gathers the requirement, designs the solution, and does the hands-on build.
IT co-owns the trade platform; the settlement process belongs to Finance.
# POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES
# Trade promotion management: platform ownership and optimization
- Act as functional owner of the TPM platform: system stability, usability, and fit to business process.
- Evaluate the effectiveness, profitability, and potential cannibalization of promotional activity.
- Work with Sales, Marketing, and Finance to align on promotions and get the most from them.
- Keep TPM data, hierarchies, and system security accurate.
- Find system gaps, limits, and performance issues, and design workarounds.
# Business analysis and solution design
- Partner with Sales and Finance to understand pain points and future-state needs.
- Turn business requirements into clear D365 designs, configurations, and process flows.
- Do the hands-on build: D365 configuration, Power Platform, Power BI and SSRS report development, scripts.
- Challenge requirements when needed to keep solutions scalable and supportable.
# User enablement and governance
- Provide functional support, training, and guidance to end users and super users.
- Write and maintain functional documentation, process flows, and user guides.
- Hold ERP governance, change management, and documentation standards.
- Handle help-desk queries from the TPM user community.
# Continuous improvement
- Monitor system usage and performance; recommend improvements.
- Support enhancements, upgrades, and new-feature adoption in D365 and the Power Platform.
- Stay current on TPM platform capabilities and best practices.
# REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
- 3 to 5 years of techno-functional experience with D365 or a comparable ERP, including hands-on configuration and report development (Power BI or SSRS).
- Ability to analyze promotion performance, spot trends, forecast results, and evaluate ROI.
- Advanced Excel: pivot tables, complex formulas, modeling, and data manipulation.
- Comfortable owning a problem end to end without much direction.
# PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Hands-on time with a TPM platform (SAP TPM, Vistex, Adesso, Oracle Demantra, or similar) and exposure to trade or deductions processes in CPG; transferable TPM experience counts.
- SQL familiarity.
- Food manufacturing, CPG, or regulated manufacturing experience.
- EDI familiarity.
# WHY THIS ROLE
- Ownership of a core ERP platform.
- Direct partnership with Sales and Finance.
- Room to shape scalable, supportable ERP solutions.
- Hybrid model with strong on-site collaboration.

- Solve real-life puzzles: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.

- High-performance environment: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.
# From learning to leading
Throughout this one-year program, you’ll own business-critical projects from start to finish right from the get-go, supported by mentorship, learning sessions, and regular feedback.
You’ll strengthen your leadership skills in project management, storytelling, stakeholder communication, and giving and receiving feedback, while sharpening your technical skills in Python, SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint.
As your scope grows, so does your responsibility.
You might scale your initial project or take on new challenges within the same domain.
Either way, there’s always a new challenge to lead and an opportunity to make an impact.
That’s why every journey is unique: there’s no standardized path through the program, just continuous opportunities to grow and lead.

From day one, you’ll be embedded in a business team, taking ownership in one of the following domains:
- Consumer Drive growth through pricing, supplier strategy, and our market strategy. Think: Shaping our successful market entry into new cities. Your decisions shape how millions of customers experience Picnic.
- Logistics Build the backbone of Picnics operations. Think: robotic fulfilment, demand forecasting, route optimization across Europe and much more
# Your superpowers
You don't wait for permission.
You see a problem, build the solution, and bring people with you, before anyone asks.
You've probably already started something: a project, a product, a business, an initiative that didn't exist until you made it happen.

- Are about to graduate (or recently graduated) a Masters in a quantitative field: e.g., mathematics, econometrics, engineering, or similar
- Have experience in high-performance environments: consulting, fast-growth startups, or competitive internships and know what it means to raise the bar
- Show an entrepreneurial mindset: you build, improve, and take ownership without being asked
- Think like a builder: hands-on, curious, and driven to challenge the status quo with practical solutions
- You have already gained basic knowledge in PowerPoint, Python, SQL, Excel or alternative coding languages

Rewarding Impact from Day One
You’ll receive an attractive compensation package, designed to reward your ambition, drive, and the direct impact you’ll make from your very first project.

English.
